<meta name="theme-color" content="#0040ff">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="ToolSeer">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">

<script>
(function() {
  var pwaConfig = {
    name: "ToolSeer",
    short_name: "ToolSeer",
    start_url: window.location.href,
    display: "standalone",
    background_color: "#ffffff",
    theme_color: "#0040ff",
    icons: [{ src: "data:image/png;base64,", sizes: "512x512", type: "image/png" }]
  };
  
  var manifestBlob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(pwaConfig)], {type: 'application/json'});
  var manifestURL = URL.createObjectURL(manifestBlob);
  var link = document.createElement('link');
  link.rel = 'manifest';
  link.href = manifestURL;
  document.head.appendChild(link);

  if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    var swCode = "self.addEventListener('install', e => e.waitUntil(self.skipWaiting())); self.addEventListener('activate', e => e.waitUntil(self.clients.claim())); self.addEventListener('fetch', e => {});";
    var swBlob = new Blob([swCode], {type: 'text/javascript'});
    navigator.serviceWorker.register(URL.createObjectURL(swBlob))
      .then(r => console.log('PWA Active'))
      .catch(e => console.log('PWA Error', e));
  }
})();
</script>
<!-- End PWA Code -->

    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    
    <!-- SEO Meta Tags -->
    <title>ToolSeer V3 - Professional PDF Tools</title>
    <meta name="description" content="ToolSeer V3: The fastest way to convert images to PDF, merge files, and manage documents online.">
    
    <!-- Favicon (Base64 SVG) -->
    <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='%233b82f6'><path d='M14,2H6A2,2 0 0,0 4,4V20A2,2 0 0,0 6,22H18A2,2 0 0,0 20,20V8L14,2M18,20H6V4H13V9H18V20M11.5,17.5L15.75,13.25L14.34,11.84L12.5,13.67V10H10.5V13.67L8.66,11.84L7.25,13.25L11.5,17.5Z'/></svg>">

    <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- jsPDF -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
    <!-- Phosphor Icons -->
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web"></script>

    <script>
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        primary: 'var(--color-primary)',
                        secondary: 'var(--color-secondary)',
                        bg: 'var(--color-bg)',
                        surface: 'var(--color-surface)',
                        text: 'var(--color-text)',
                        muted: 'var(--color-muted)',
                    },
                    animation: {
                        'fade-in': 'fadeIn 0.5s ease-out',
                        'slide-up': 'slideUp 0.5s ease-out',
                        'pulse-slow': 'pulse 3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite',
                    },
                    keyframes: {
                        fadeIn: {
                            '0%': { opacity: '0' },
                            '100%': { opacity: '1' },
                        },
                        slideUp: {
                            '0%': { opacity: '0', transform: 'translateY(20px)' },
                            '100%': { opacity: '1', transform: 'translateY(0)' },
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </script>

    <style>
        :root {
            --color-primary: #2563eb; /* Enterprise Blue */
            --color-secondary: #60a5fa;
            --color-bg: #f8fafc;
            --color-surface: #ffffff;
            --color-text: #0f172a;
            --color-muted: #64748b;
        }

        [data-theme="dark"] {
            --color-primary: #3b82f6;
            --color-secondary: #60a5fa;
            --color-bg: #0f172a;
            --color-surface: #1e293b;
            --color-text: #f8fafc;
            --color-muted: #94a3b8;
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--color-bg);
            color: var(--color-text);
            transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .surface-card {
            background-color: var(--color-surface);
            border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
        }

        /* Intro Animation Styles */
        #intro-screen {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background-color: var(--color-bg);
            z-index: 9999;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease-out, visibility 0.5s;
        }
        
        .intro-logo {
            animation: introScale 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        @keyframes introScale {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); }
            50% { opacity: 1; }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
        }

        /* RTL Specifics */
        [dir="rtl"] .ph-caret-right { transform: rotate(180deg); }
        [dir="rtl"] .ph-arrow-right { transform: rotate(180deg); }
        
        /* Custom Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--color-muted); border-radius: 10px; opacity: 0.3; }

        .drop-zone.active { border-color: var(--color-primary); background-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.05); }

        /* --- SIDEBAR VISIBILITY FIX --- */
        /* Default Mobile State: Hidden off-screen */
        #settingsSidebar {
            transform: translateX(-100%); /* LTR default hidden */
        }
        
        /* RTL Mobile State */
        [dir="rtl"] #settingsSidebar {
            transform: translateX(100%); /* RTL default hidden */
        }

        /* Mobile Active State (Toggled via JS) */
        #settingsSidebar.active-sidebar {
            transform: translateX(0) !important;
        }

        /* Desktop State: ALWAYS VISIBLE */
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            #settingsSidebar {
                transform: translateX(0) !important;
                visibility: visible !important;
                position: relative !important;
            }
        }
    </style>

<body class="h-screen flex overflow-hidden font-sans selection:bg-primary selection:text-white">

    <!-- 1. INTRO SPLASH SCREEN -->
    <div id="intro-screen">
        <div class="intro-logo flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
            <!-- Modern SVG Logo -->
            <div class="w-24 h-24 bg-primary rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl shadow-blue-500/40 text-white">
                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-14 h-14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                    <path d="M14,2H6A2,2 0 0,0 4,4V20A2,2 0 0,0 6,22H18A2,2 0 0,0 20,20V8L14,2M18,20H6V4H13V9H18V20M11.5,17.5L15.75,13.25L14.34,11.84L12.5,13.67V10H10.5V13.67L8.66,11.84L7.25,13.25L11.5,17.5Z"/>
                </svg>
            </div>
            <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-text">ToolSeer <span class="text-primary">V3</span></h1>
            <p class="text-muted text-sm tracking-widest uppercase">Professional Web Tools</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Mobile Sidebar Overlay -->
    <div id="sidebarOverlay" onclick="toggleSidebar()" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-40 hidden md:hidden backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity opacity-0"></div>

    <!-- Sidebar Settings (Drawer on Mobile, Sidebar on Desktop) -->
    <!-- UPDATED: Removed conflicting Tailwind transform classes, relying on CSS for stable Desktop visibility -->
    <aside id="settingsSidebar" class="fixed md:relative inset-y-0 start-0 z-50 w-80 surface-card flex flex-col border-r border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-2xl md:shadow-none transition-transform duration-300 md:flex">
        <div class="p-6 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div class="w-10 h-10 bg-primary rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30">
                    <i class="ph ph-sliders-horizontal text-xl"></i>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h1 class="font-bold text-lg tracking-tight" data-i18n="settings_title">Configuration</h1>
                    <p class="text-xs text-muted" data-i18n="settings_subtitle">Customize Output</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- Close Button (Mobile Only) -->
            <button onclick="toggleSidebar()" class="md:hidden text-muted hover:text-primary p-2">
                <i class="ph ph-x text-xl"></i>
            </button>
        </div>

        <div class="p-6 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-6">
            
            <!-- Page Size -->
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted mb-2" data-i18n="lbl_page_size">Page Size</label>
                <select id="pageSize" class="w-full p-3 rounded-lg surface-card border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary outline-none transition-all text-sm">
                    <option value="a4">A4 (Standard)</option>
                    <option value="letter">Letter (US)</option>
                    <option value="fit">Fit to Image</option>
                </select>
            </div>

            <!-- Orientation -->
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted mb-2" data-i18n="lbl_orientation">Orientation</label>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <button onclick="setOrientation('p')" id="btn-portrait" class="p-3 rounded-lg border border-primary bg-primary text-white flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all shadow-md">
                        <i class="ph ph-file-text text-xl"></i>
                        <span class="text-xs font-medium" data-i18n="btn_portrait">Portrait</span>
                    </button>
                    <button onclick="setOrientation('l')" id="btn-landscape" class="p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 surface-card text-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-primary flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all">
                        <i class="ph ph-file-text bg-transparent rotate-90 text-xl"></i>
                        <span class="text-xs font-medium" data-i18n="btn_landscape">Landscape</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Margins -->
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted mb-2" data-i18n="lbl_margins">Margins</label>
                <select id="margins" class="w-full p-3 rounded-lg surface-card border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary outline-none transition-all text-sm">
                    <option value="none" data-i18n="opt_no_margin">No Margins</option>
                    <option value="small" selected data-i18n="opt_small_margin">Small</option>
                    <option value="large" data-i18n="opt_large_margin">Large</option>
                </select>
            </div>

            <hr class="border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">

            <!-- Compression -->
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted mb-2" data-i18n="lbl_compression">Compression</label>
                <select id="compression" class="w-full p-3 rounded-lg surface-card border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary outline-none transition-all text-sm">
                    <option value="NONE" data-i18n="opt_comp_none">High Quality (No Comp)</option>
                    <option value="FAST" selected data-i18n="opt_comp_med">Balanced (Recommended)</option>
                    <option value="SLOW" data-i18n="opt_comp_high">Small Size (High Comp)</option>
                </select>
            </div>

            <!-- Quality Slider -->
            <div>
                <label class="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted mb-2" data-i18n="lbl_quality">Image Quality</label>
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted mb-2">
                    <span data-i18n="lbl_low">Low</span>
                    <span data-i18n="lbl_high">High</span>
                </div>
                <input type="range" id="imgQuality" min="0.1" max="1.0" step="0.1" value="0.8" class="w-full h-1.5 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-primary">
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Footer / Version -->
        <div class="p-4 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div class="flex justify-center gap-2 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 p-1.5 rounded-full">
                <button onclick="setTheme('light')" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-gray-600 shadow-sm transition-all text-gray-500"><i class="ph ph-sun"></i></button>
                <button onclick="setTheme('dark')" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-gray-600 transition-all text-gray-500"><i class="ph ph-moon"></i></button>
            </div>
            <div class="text-center flex flex-col gap-1">
                <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted opacity-60">ToolSeer Version 3.0</span>
                <!-- Disclaimer Link -->
                <button onclick="openDisclaimer()" class="text-[10px] text-muted hover:text-primary transition-colors underline decoration-dotted">
                    Disclaimer / إخلاء مسؤولية
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- Main Content -->
    <main class="flex-1 flex flex-col relative w-full overflow-hidden bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-[#0b1120]">
        
        <!-- Header -->
        <header class="h-16 md:h-20 surface-card border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex items-center justify-between px-4 md:px-8 shrink-0 z-10 backdrop-blur-md bg-opacity-90">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
                <button onclick="toggleSidebar()" class="md:hidden text-2xl text-muted p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors"><i class="ph ph-list"></i></button>
                
                <!-- Logo Area -->
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3 group cursor-pointer" onclick="switchView('converter')">
                    <div class="w-8 h-8 md:w-9 md:h-9 bg-primary text-white rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14,2H6A2,2 0 0,0 4,4V20A2,2 0 0,0 6,22H18A2,2 0 0,0 20,20V8L14,2M18,20H6V4H13V9H18V20M11.5,17.5L15.75,13.25L14.34,11.84L12.5,13.67V10H10.5V13.67L8.66,11.84L7.25,13.25L11.5,17.5Z"/></svg>
                    </div>
                    <span class="font-bold text-lg md:text-xl tracking-tight hidden sm:block">ToolSeer</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Navigation -->
                <nav class="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1 ml-6 rtl:mr-6 rtl:ml-0">
                    <button onclick="switchView('converter')" id="nav-converter" class="nav-link active px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-muted hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-2" data-i18n="nav_converter">
                        <i class="ph ph-image"></i> Converter
                    </button>
                    <button onclick="switchView('works')" id="nav-works" class="nav-link px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-muted hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-2" data-i18n="nav_works">
                        <i class="ph ph-briefcase"></i> Our Works
                    </button>
                    <button onclick="switchView('contact')" id="nav-contact" class="nav-link px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-muted hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-2" data-i18n="nav_contact">
                        <i class="ph ph-paper-plane-tilt"></i> Contact
                    </button>
                </nav>
            </div>

            <!-- Right Actions -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-4">
                <!-- Language Switcher -->
                <button onclick="toggleLanguage()" class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 md:px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors">
                    <i class="ph ph-globe text-muted"></i>
                    <span id="lang-label" class="text-xs font-bold text-muted hidden sm:inline">العربية</span>
                </button>

                <button class="bg-primary text-white px-3 md:px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20">
                    <i class="ph ph-crown"></i> <span class="hidden sm:inline" data-i18n="btn_pro">Upgrade</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <!-- View: Converter -->
        <section id="view-converter" class="view-section flex-1 p-4 md:p-10 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col items-center relative animate-fade-in w-full">
            
            <div class="text-center mb-6 md:mb-8 max-w-2xl w-full">
                <h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold mb-3 tracking-tight" data-i18n="hero_title">Convert Images to PDF</h2>
                <p class="text-muted text-xs md:text-sm leading-relaxed px-2" data-i18n="hero_desc">Drag and drop your JPG or PNG files. Rearrange them in the perfect order, adjust compression, and download your professional PDF document instantly.</p>
            </div>

            <!-- Drag & Drop Zone -->
            <div id="dropZone" class="drop-zone w-full max-w-5xl h-48 md:h-56 rounded-3xl border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer surface-card hover:shadow-lg transition-all mb-8 md:mb-10 relative group mx-auto">
                <input type="file" id="fileInput" multiple accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/jpg" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10">
                <div class="text-center pointer-events-none group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300">
                    <div class="w-12 h-12 md:w-16 md:h-16 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-primary rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3 md:mb-4 text-2xl md:text-3xl shadow-inner">
                        <i class="ph ph-cloud-arrow-up"></i>
                    </div>
                    <h3 class="text-base md:text-lg font-bold mb-1" data-i18n="drop_title">Click or Drag images here</h3>
                    <p class="text-muted text-[10px] md:text-xs" data-i18n="drop_subtitle">Supports High Res JPG, PNG</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- File List (Preview) -->
            <div id="fileListContainer" class="w-full max-w-5xl hidden flex-1 flex flex-col">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 md:mb-6 px-1">
                    <h3 class="font-bold text-base md:text-lg flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span data-i18n="preview_title">Project Workspace</span>
                        <span class="text-xs font-normal text-white bg-primary px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full"><span id="fileCount">0</span></span>
                    </h3>
                    <button onclick="clearAll()" class="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors" data-i18n="btn_clear">Clear Workspace</button>
                </div>
                
                <div id="previewGrid" class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 md:gap-5 mb-32 w-full">
                    <!-- Dynamic Content -->
                </div>

                <!-- Floating Action Bar -->
                <div class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-[90%] md:w-auto min-w-[280px] md:min-w-[320px] surface-card p-2 pr-2 pl-4 md:pl-6 rounded-full shadow-2xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 md:gap-6 z-30 animate-slide-up">
                    <div class="hidden md:block">
                        <div class="text-xs font-bold text-primary" data-i18n="status_ready">Ready to Process</div>
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="convertFiles()" id="convertBtn" class="flex-1 md:flex-none bg-primary text-white px-6 md:px-8 py-3 rounded-full font-bold shadow-lg hover:shadow-blue-500/40 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm md:text-base">
                        <i class="ph ph-magic-wand"></i>
                        <span data-i18n="btn_convert">Generate PDF</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Empty State -->
            <div id="emptyState" class="text-center max-w-md mt-4 md:mt-8 opacity-40">
                <i class="ph ph-images text-6xl md:text-7xl text-muted mb-4"></i>
                <p class="text-sm font-medium" data-i18n="empty_state">No images added yet.</p>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- View: Our Works -->
        <section id="view-works" class="view-section hidden flex-1 p-4 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto animate-fade-in w-full">
            <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full">
                <div class="text-center mb-8 md:mb-12">
                    <h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold mb-3" data-i18n="works_title">Our Ecosystem</h2>
                    <p class="text-muted text-sm" data-i18n="works_desc">Professional tools built for the community.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-6 pb-12">
                    <!-- Project Cards (Sample) -->
                    <a href="#" class="surface-card p-6 rounded-2xl hover:border-primary transition-all group hover:shadow-xl">
                        <div class="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">

    <!-- Processing Overlay -->
    <div id="processingOverlay" class="fixed inset-0 bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#0b1120]/95 z-50 hidden flex flex-col items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-sm">

            <div class="absolute inset-0 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>

    </div>

    <script data-cfasync="false" src="/cdn-cgi/scripts/5c5dd728/cloudflare-static/email-decode.min.js"></script><script>
        // --- Translations (i18n) ---
        const translations = {
            en: {
                settings_title: "Configuration",
                settings_subtitle: "Customize Output",
                lbl_page_size: "Page Size",
                lbl_orientation: "Orientation",
                btn_portrait: "Portrait",
                btn_landscape: "Landscape",
                lbl_margins: "Margins",
                opt_no_margin: "No Margins",
                opt_small_margin: "Small",
                opt_large_margin: "Large",

                opt_comp_none: "High Quality (No Comp)",
                opt_comp_med: "Balanced (Recommended)",
                opt_comp_high: "Small Size (High Comp)",
                lbl_quality: "Image Quality",
                lbl_low: "Low",
                lbl_high: "High",
                nav_converter: "Converter",
                nav_works: "Our Works",
                nav_contact: "Contact",
                btn_pro: "Upgrade",
                hero_title: "Convert Images to PDF",
                hero_desc: "Drag and drop your JPG or PNG files. Rearrange them in the perfect order, adjust compression, and download your professional PDF document instantly.",
                drop_title: "Click or Drag images here",
                drop_subtitle: "Supports High Res JPG, PNG",
                preview_title: "Project Workspace",
                btn_clear: "Clear Workspace",
                status_ready: "Ready to Process",
                btn_convert: "Generate PDF",
                empty_state: "No images added yet.",
                works_title: "Our Ecosystem",
                works_desc: "Professional tools built for the community.",
                contact_title: "Get in Touch",
                contact_desc: "We value your feedback and support. Reach out to us for inquiries or collaborations.",
                modal_success_title: "Success!",
                modal_success_desc: "Your PDF is ready for download.",
                btn_download: "Download PDF",
                btn_close: "Close",
                processing_title: "Processing...",
                processing_desc: "Optimizing images and generating document",
                disclaimer_modal_title: "Disclaimer & Terms",
                btn_acknowledge: "I Understand / فهمت"
            },
            ar: {
                settings_title: "الإعدادات",
                settings_subtitle: "تخصيص المخرجات",
                lbl_page_size: "حجم الصفحة",
                lbl_orientation: "الاتجاه",
                btn_portrait: "طولي",
                btn_landscape: "عرضي",
                lbl_margins: "الهوامش",
                opt_no_margin: "بدون هوامش",
                opt_small_margin: "صغيرة",
                opt_large_margin: "كبيرة",
                lbl_compression: "الضغط",
                opt_comp_none: "جودة عالية (بدون ضغط)",
                opt_comp_med: "متوازن (موصى به)",
                opt_comp_high: "حجم صغير (ضغط عالي)",
                lbl_quality: "جودة الصورة",
                lbl_low: "منخفضة",
                lbl_high: "عالية",
                nav_converter: "المحول",
                nav_works: "أعمالنا",
                nav_contact: "اتصل بنا",
                btn_pro: "ترقية",
                hero_title: "تحويل الصور إلى PDF",
                hero_desc: "قم بسحب وإفلات ملفات JPG أو PNG. أعد ترتيبها، اضبط الضغط، وقم بتنزيل مستند PDF الاحترافي الخاص بك فوراً.",
                drop_title: "انقر أو اسحب الصور هنا",
                drop_subtitle: "يدعم JPG, PNG عالية الدقة",
                preview_title: "مساحة العمل",
                btn_clear: "مسح الكل",
                status_ready: "جاهز للمعالجة",
                btn_convert: "إنشاء PDF",
                empty_state: "لم يتم إضافة صور بعد.",
                works_title: "نظامنا البيئي",
                works_desc: "أدوات احترافية تم بناؤها للمجتمع.",
                contact_title: "تواصل معنا",
                contact_desc: "نحن نقدر ملاحظاتك ودعمك. تواصل معنا للاستفسارات أو التعاون.",
                modal_success_title: "تم بنجاح!",
                modal_success_desc: "ملف PDF جاهز للتنزيل.",
                btn_download: "تنزيل الملف",
                btn_close: "إغلاق",
                processing_title: "جاري المعالجة...",
                processing_desc: "تحسين الصور وإنشاء المستند",
                disclaimer_modal_title: "إخلاء المسؤولية والشروط",
                btn_acknowledge: "فهمت / I Understand"
            }
        };

        let currentLang = 'en';

        // --- Intro Logic ---
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                const intro = document.getElementById('intro-screen');
                intro.style.opacity = '0';
                intro.style.visibility = 'hidden';
            }, 2000); // Exactly 2 seconds
        });

        // --- Language Switcher Logic ---
        function toggleLanguage() {
            currentLang = currentLang === 'en' ? 'ar' : 'en';
            updateLanguage();
        }

        function updateLanguage() {
            const t = translations[currentLang];
            const html = document.documentElement;
            const langLabel = document.getElementById('lang-label');

            // Set Direction & Lang Attribute
            html.lang = currentLang;
            html.dir = currentLang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';

            // Update Switcher Label
            langLabel.innerText = currentLang === 'en' ? 'العربية' : 'English';

            // Update Text Content
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (t[key]) {
                    if(el.tagName === 'OPTION') {
                        el.text = t[key];
                    } else {
                        el.innerText = t[key];
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // --- Disclaimer Logic ---
        const disclaimerModal = document.getElementById('disclaimerModal');
        
        function openDisclaimer() {
            disclaimerModal.classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function closeDisclaimer() {
            disclaimerModal.classList.add('hidden');
        }

        // --- Core Application Logic ---
        let files = [];
        let currentOrientation = 'p'; 
        let generatedPdfBlob = null;
        let dragSrcEl = null;

        const dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');
        const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput');
        const fileListContainer = document.getElementById('fileListContainer');
        const previewGrid = document.getElementById('previewGrid');
        const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
        const fileCount = document.getElementById('fileCount');
        const processingOverlay = document.getElementById('processingOverlay');
        const successModal = document.getElementById('successModal');
        const settingsSidebar = document.getElementById('settingsSidebar');

        function switchView(viewName) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.view-section').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active', 'text-primary', 'bg-blue-50', 'dark:bg-blue-900/20'));

            if (viewName === 'converter') {
                document.getElementById('view-converter').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('nav-converter').classList.add('active', 'text-primary', 'bg-blue-50', 'dark:bg-blue-900/20');
            } else if (viewName === 'works') {
                document.getElementById('view-works').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('nav-works').classList.add('active', 'text-primary', 'bg-blue-50', 'dark:bg-blue-900/20');
            } else if (viewName === 'contact') {
                document.getElementById('view-contact').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('nav-contact').classList.add('active', 'text-primary', 'bg-blue-50', 'dark:bg-blue-900/20');
            }
        }

        // --- Responsive Sidebar Logic (UPDATED) ---
        function toggleSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('settingsSidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
            
            // Toggle active class for mobile
            sidebar.classList.toggle('active-sidebar');

            // Toggle Overlay
            overlay.classList.toggle('hidden');
            if (!overlay.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                setTimeout(() => overlay.classList.remove('opacity-0'), 10);
            } else {
                overlay.classList.add('opacity-0');
            }
        }

        function setTheme(themeName) {
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', themeName);
        }

        function setOrientation(orient) {
            currentOrientation = orient;
            const pBtn = document.getElementById('btn-portrait');
            const lBtn = document.getElementById('btn-landscape');
            
            const activeClass = "p-3 rounded-lg border border-primary bg-primary text-white flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all shadow-md";
            const inactiveClass = "p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 surface-card text-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-primary flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all";

            if (orient === 'p') {
                pBtn.className = activeClass;
                lBtn.className = inactiveClass;
            } else {
                lBtn.className = activeClass;
                pBtn.className = inactiveClass;
            }
        }

        // Drag & Drop
        dropZone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); dropZone.classList.add('active'); });
        dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => { dropZone.classList.remove('active'); });
        dropZone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); dropZone.classList.remove('active'); handleFiles(e.dataTransfer.files); });
        fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => { handleFiles(e.target.files); });

        function handleFiles(newFiles) {
            const validFiles = Array.from(newFiles).filter(file => file.type.match(/image.*/));
            if (validFiles.length === 0 && newFiles.length > 0) { alert('Invalid file type'); return; }

            let processedCount = 0;
            validFiles.forEach(file => {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = (e) => {
                    files.push({ id: Date.now() + Math.random(), name: file.name, data: e.target.result });
                    processedCount++;
                    if (processedCount === validFiles.length) updateUI();
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            });
        }

        function updateUI() {
            if (files.length > 0) {
                fileListContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
                fileCount.innerText = files.length;
                renderPreviews();
            } else {
                fileListContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        function renderPreviews() {
            previewGrid.innerHTML = '';
            files.forEach((file, index) => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'draggable-item surface-card rounded-xl p-2 relative group hover:shadow-lg transition-all select-none border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800';
                card.draggable = true;
                card.dataset.index = index;

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="aspect-[3/4] bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg mb-2 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center relative pointer-events-none">
                        <img src="${file.data}" class="object-cover w-full h-full" alt="${file.name}">
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
                        <span class="bg-primary text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">${index + 1}</span>
                        <p class="text-[10px] truncate max-w-[80px] text-muted">${file.name}</p>
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="removeFile(${index})" class="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-red-500 text-white w-6 h-6 rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center shadow-md z-10 hover:scale-110">
                        <i class="ph ph-x text-xs"></i>
                    </button>
                `;
                addDragEvents(card);
                previewGrid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function addDragEvents(item) {
            item.addEventListener('dragstart', function(e) {
                this.style.opacity = '0.4';
                dragSrcEl = this;
                e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
                e.dataTransfer.setData('text/html', this.innerHTML);
            });
            item.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) {
                if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
                e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
                return false;
            });
            item.addEventListener('dragenter', function() { this.classList.add('border-primary', 'border-2', 'border-dashed'); });
            item.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { this.classList.remove('border-primary', 'border-2', 'border-dashed'); });
            item.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
                if (e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
                if (dragSrcEl !== this) {
                    const srcIndex = parseInt(dragSrcEl.dataset.index);
                    const targetIndex = parseInt(this.dataset.index);
                    const temp = files[srcIndex];
                    files.splice(srcIndex, 1);
                    files.splice(targetIndex, 0, temp);
                    updateUI();
                }
                return false;
            });
            item.addEventListener('dragend', function() {
                this.style.opacity = '1';
                document.querySelectorAll('.draggable-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('border-primary', 'border-2', 'border-dashed'));
            });
        }

        function removeFile(index) { files.splice(index, 1); updateUI(); }
        function clearAll() { files = []; updateUI(); }

        async function convertFiles() {
            if (files.length === 0) return;
            processingOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');

            setTimeout(async () => {
                const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
                const pageSize = document.getElementById('pageSize').value;
                const marginSetting = document.getElementById('margins').value;
                const compressionLevel = document.getElementById('compression').value;
                
                let format = pageSize === 'fit' ? 'a4' : pageSize;
                const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: currentOrientation, unit: 'mm', format: format, compress: compressionLevel !== 'NONE' });

                const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
                const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
                let margin = marginSetting === 'small' ? 10 : (marginSetting === 'large' ? 20 : 0);
                const contentWidth = pageWidth - (margin * 2);
                const contentHeight = pageHeight - (margin * 2);

                for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
                    if (i > 0) doc.addPage();
                    const imgData = files[i].data;
                    const img = new Image();
                    img.src = imgData;
                    
                    // Simple aspect ratio calculation
                    const imgProps = doc.getImageProperties(imgData);
                    const imgRatio = imgProps.width / imgProps.height;
                    const pageRatio = contentWidth / contentHeight;
                    let finalW, finalH;

                    if (imgRatio > pageRatio) { finalW = contentWidth; finalH = contentWidth / imgRatio; }
                    else { finalH = contentHeight; finalW = contentHeight * imgRatio; }

                    const x = margin + (contentWidth - finalW) / 2;
                    const y = margin + (contentHeight - finalH) / 2;
                    doc.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', x, y, finalW, finalH, undefined, compressionLevel, 0);
                }

                generatedPdfBlob = doc.output('blob');
                processingOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
                successModal.classList.remove('hidden');
            }, 1500);
        }

        function downloadPDF() {
            if (generatedPdfBlob) {
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(generatedPdfBlob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `ToolSeer_V3_${Date.now()}.pdf`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                closeModal();
            }
        }

        function closeModal() {
            successModal.classList.add('hidden');
            clearAll();
        }

        // Init
        setTheme('light');
    </script>

  line-height: 38px;

  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

}

/* Adjust body padding so content isn’t hidden behind the bar */
body {

}

}
